snippet.title: Crab Crawl On Sale Now!
snippet.description:
Crab Crawl is now on sale! 

A hungry crab saves the bay!

A short, cheerful action-adventure game where you guide a crab in search of food. Avoid a variety of predators, sea-born obstacles, litterers, rival crustaceans, and explore the hostile waters to find all the tasty treats.

Buy it on:
🦀 Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3254550/Crab_Crawl
🦀 Itch - https://patientrock.itch.io/crab-crawl
